description: React component 'AssignmentList' for displaying and creating assignments within a role-based learning management system. Handles loading lessons and assignments, creating new assignments, and conditional UI rendering based on user roles.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches lessons and assignments from the API based on current role, updates state.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new assignment with selected lesson and assignee details, then reloads the data.
